text:
Ana S: FYI support ticket #4567 — customer reports p99 latency doubled after we switched to int8 quant profile on model redwood/phi-7b at ~2026-03-09T14:02Z. p95 up ~20%, p99 ~2x. attaching heatmap link: https://rwd-internal/trace/4567 :cry:
Max T: Can you paste the exact profile name and the rollout id? Also need the request payload size and typical seq_len.
Ana S: Profile=phi-7b-int8-v2, rollout=rollout-20260309-phi7b, sample seq_len ~512 (chat turns ~2-3). payload ~300 tokens.
Priya R: Based on the summary: likely quantization calibration edge-case. Two quick possibilities: (1) calibration sample set too small -> hits slow calibration code path, (2) fallback to slow path in kernel (fp16 emulation) for certain ops. Did customer enable dynamic_fp8?
Ana S: They enabled int8 + use_fp8=false. Calibration sample_count was 12 (from support logs).
Max T: Repro steps I used locally:
```
# reproduce load in k8s test cluster
ab -n 2000 -c 8 -p sample.json -T application/json \
  "https://test-rwd/api/generate?model=phi-7b&quant=int8&calib=true"
```
I saw p99 jump from ~420ms -> 1.7s when calibration file missing / incomplete. Kernel stalling logs: `quant_calibrate: sample_count=12 < threshold 50 -> entering safe_slow_path`
Jordan L: Is this customer on Dedicated or Hosted? If Dedicated we can rollback their profile quickly.
Ana S: Hosted. Customer is high-traffic (prod). Impacting background inference and interactive features.
Priya R: Immediate mitigations: rollback profile to previous fp16/int8-mixed, enable per-customer fp16 fallback on tail-latency-sensitive routes, increase calibration sample_count threshold and persist calibration artifacts. Long-term: make "safe_slow_path" emit metric and cause automatic fallback after N slow calibrations.
Max T: Quick check — the quantization code path logs are noisy but I found stacktrace pointing to `quantize_layer_kvcache()` where a mutex wait spikes when sample_count low. I can push a hotfix to avoid full mutex on first calibration step.
Jordan L: I'll perform a rollback for this customer's active rollout now. Using the console rollback api: `POST /api/v1/rollouts/rollout-20260309-phi7b/rollback`
deploy-bot: rollback accepted, rollout-20260309-phi7b -> rollback-to: rollout-20260225-phi7b (id: rb-20260309-01).
deploy-bot: rollback completed on 3 nodes (region us-west-2).
Ana S: Customer confirms initial improvement — p99 down to ~480ms after rollback. They're still seeing occasional spikes during busy windows.
Priya R: Follow-ups (owners):
- Priya R: increase default calibration samples to 128 for int8 profiles and add persisted artifact upload (config change + tests).
- Max T: hotfix to quant kernel to remove heavy mutex during first calibration. Add unit test to simulate small sample sets.
- Jordan L: add rollback playbook snippet for hosted customers (fast rollback + warm cache).
- Ana S: run warmup replay job for customer to repopulate KV cache (I/O safe warmup script with recorded traces).
Max T: Short-term traffic mitigation: set max_batch_size=1 for this customer's routes, and add a route-level override to force fp16 on tails. That reduced p99 under load in my tests.
Ana S: Repro snippet for support engineers (copy/paste):
```
# warmup KV cache
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood/warmer \
  -d '{"model":"phi-7b","profile":"phi-7b-int8-v2","replay_size":500}'
```
support-bot: Created internal incident INC-20260309-quant-p99 for tracking.
Jordan L: I'll also schedule a canary rollout for the fixed profile with increased calibration samples and smoke-tests before global roll.
Priya R: Note for product: we should add a profile metadata flag `tail_latency_sensitive` that forces more conservative calibration and enables fp16 fallback by default.
Ana S: Customer is OK with rollback for now, wants ETA on hard fix. Priya/Max, can you give an ETA for fix + canary?
Max T: Hotfix branch ready, running CI. If green, canary deploy in ~24h.
Priya R: Config change + updated calibration job + tests — ~48h to canary.
Ana S: Thanks. I'll keep customer updated and paste confirmation here.
Jordan L: Closing loop: created runbook PR with steps for rollback + warmup + route override (PR #812). Will link after merge.
Ana S: Customer confirms stable for 30m, p99 back to expected range. Marking ticket as "mitigated" pending root-cause fix.
Max T: I'll add a telemetry alert: `quantization.slow_path_rate > 0.5%` -> page on-call.
Priya R: Adding QA test vectors for small-sample calibration to prevent regressions.
Ana S: Thanks all :thumbsup: We'll reopen if spikes return.
